nodes.label: Maghrebi Heritage Visual Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Design direction using riads, zellige tiles, carved stucco, warm earth tones and craft textures to localize the Airbnb concept for Algeria.

nodes.label: incident.png - Safety First Banner
nodes.rationale: Grey-to-brown gradient banner with teal 'SAFETY FIRST' eyebrow and serif headline 'Your security is our highest priority.' Header art for the safety / incident-reporting flow. No reference found in front/lib (possibly unused or superseded by safehousing.png).

nodes.label: khayt.png - Stitched Leather Texture
nodes.rationale: Close-up of brown leather with two parallel gold stitch lines ('khayt' = thread in Arabic). Decorative artisanal texture used as header in settings/Login & Security/Two_step_verif.dart; conveys craftsmanship and trust.

nodes.label: marhaban.png - Moorish Courtyard Welcome Art
nodes.rationale: Rendered Maghrebi riad interior: carved stucco arches, green zellige tiles, green tiled roof, central marble fountain, checkered floor. 'Marhaban' = welcome; background of authentication-front/sign_in_screens/Mar7aban.dart, setting a warm local-heritage hospitality mood.

nodes.label: safehousing.png - Cozy Traditional Salon
nodes.rationale: Warm-lit traditional Algerian/Maghrebi salon with striped floor cushions along walls, carved wooden low table, rug. Conveys safe, homely lodging; header image in settings/Get help with sfety issues/safety_guide.dart and reporting_an_incident.dart.

nodes.label: w.png - Riad Doorway Through Shutters
nodes.rationale: View through open wooden mashrabiya shutters into a riad courtyard with carved arch, wooden door, blue zellige, fountain and potted plants. Used in home-front/Host/create_listing_intro_page.dart to invite hosts to open their home.

nodes.label: Traditional Maghrebi architecture visual identity (arches, zellige, courtyards)
nodes.norm_label: traditional maghrebi architecture visual identity (arches, zellige, courtyards)
nodes.rationale: Recurring art direction across auth/onboarding backgrounds: warm ochre tones, horseshoe arches, carved plaster, zellige mosaics, orange-tree courtyards - positioning the app around authentic local heritage.

nodes.label: authentically.png - Courtyard orange tree with zellige tiles (onboarding + How it works)
nodes.norm_label: authentically.png - courtyard orange tree with zellige tiles (onboarding + how it works)
nodes.rationale: Tall portrait full-bleed background: an orange tree in a traditional courtyard with ochre walls, zellige mosaic wainscoting and a checkered green/white tiled floor. Used as an onboarding carousel background (onboarding_screens/authentically.dart) and in settings/how_works.dart; conveys authentic, heritage-rich living.

nodes.label: courtyard.png - Ornate arched wooden door between orange trees (login courtyard screen)
nodes.norm_label: courtyard.png - ornate arched wooden door between orange trees (login courtyard screen)
nodes.rationale: Tall portrait background: carved-stucco horseshoe arch over a studded wooden double door, green tiled roof, zellige panels, flanked by orange trees and a paved path. Used by Login_screens/courtyard.dart as the auth entry backdrop; the door metaphor suggests 'entering' the app/home.

nodes.label: google.png - Ornate arched doorway background (Google sign-in screen)
nodes.norm_label: google.png - ornate arched doorway background (google sign-in screen)
nodes.rationale: Despite the filename, this is not a Google logo: a tall portrait photo of a carved-stucco horseshoe arch with lattice plasterwork, studded wooden double door with ring knockers, and zellige tile panels. Used as the background in Login_screens/signin_google.dart; the filename refers to the screen, not the content.

nodes.label: Four-Point Star Brand Motif (gold/teal/brown)
nodes.rationale: Recurring brand element: gold four-pointed star with teal center on dark brown, reused as subtle watermark on backgrounds.

nodes.label: logo for main.png - Splash Logo (Four-Point Star)
nodes.norm_label: logo for main.png - splash logo (four-point star)
nodes.rationale: Brand mark: gold outlined four-pointed star with teal center dot on dark brown square. Full-bleed version used on authentication-front/splash_screen/splash_screen.dart.

nodes.label: logo.png - App Icon Logo
nodes.rationale: Same gold four-point star with teal dot on dark brown, rounded-square app-icon shape. Used in home-front/widgets/Landing_app_bar.dart and OTP screens (verifCODE.dart, Choose_method.dart, reset_password_method.dart).

nodes.label: phonenumber.png - Cream Background with Star Watermark
nodes.norm_label: phonenumber.png - cream background with star watermark
nodes.rationale: Tall phone-sized cream background with faint beige four-point star (brand motif) cropped at bottom right. Intended as a backdrop for a phone-number entry screen; no reference found in front/lib.

nodes.label: Background.svg - Home/Buildings Icon in Beige Circle Badge
nodes.norm_label: background.svg - home/buildings icon in beige circle badge

nodes.label: Central_avatar+base.svg - Person Avatar in Peach Circle
nodes.norm_label: central_avatar+base.svg - person avatar in peach circle

nodes.label: floating_element_reprentingProfile.svg - ID Badge on Cyan Circle
nodes.norm_label: floating_element_reprentingprofile.svg - id badge on cyan circle

nodes.label: Authentic Algerian hospitality / traditional interiors
nodes.rationale: Interior salon imagery (banquettes, tea/jug on round table, warm light) used to sell the idea of welcoming, authentic stays to guests and hosts.

nodes.label: authentic_stays.png - Traditional salon seating with tea set (used in create_listing_basics_page.dart)
nodes.norm_label: authentic_stays.png - traditional salon seating with tea set (used in create_listing_basics_page.dart)
nodes.rationale: Small landscape photo of a traditional North African salon: kilim-patterned cushions and banquettes, carved wooden round table with brass teapot and tea glasses, warm sunlight. Used in the host Create Listing basics page (front/lib/home-front/Host/create_listing_basics_page.dart) to evoke the 'authentic stay' a host is about to list.

nodes.label: hospitality.png - Warm vaulted sitting room with arched window (onboarding hospitality screen)
nodes.norm_label: hospitality.png - warm vaulted sitting room with arched window (onboarding hospitality screen)
nodes.rationale: Tall portrait background: a golden-lit vaulted room with an arched shuttered window, striped red banquette seating and a round wooden table holding a ceramic jug. Used in onboarding_screens/hospitality.dart; conveys welcoming traditional hospitality.

nodes.label: discover.png - Mediterranean coastline seascape (first onboarding screen)
nodes.norm_label: discover.png - mediterranean coastline seascape (first onboarding screen)
nodes.rationale: Tall portrait background: calm sea with a forested rocky headland and blue sky with contrails, darkening toward the bottom (gradient for overlaid text). Used in onboarding_screens/discover.dart, which leads to authentically.dart; conveys discovering Algeria's coast.

nodes.label: discoverAlgeria.png - Whitewashed hillside medina at golden hour (How it works)
nodes.norm_label: discoveralgeria.png - whitewashed hillside medina at golden hour (how it works)
nodes.rationale: Small landscape photo of dense white cube houses cascading down a hill toward the sea at sunset, reminiscent of the Casbah of Algiers. Used as a card image in settings/how_works.dart for the 'discover Algeria' step.

nodes.label: Icon (1).svg - Mosque/Palace with Domes and Minarets
nodes.norm_label: icon (1).svg - mosque/palace with domes and minarets

nodes.label: default_avatar.png - Faded grayscale portrait placeholder avatar (signUP_step3)
nodes.norm_label: default_avatar.png - faded grayscale portrait placeholder avatar (signup_step3)
nodes.rationale: Small square, heavily desaturated/washed-out profile photo of a person in side view. Serves as the placeholder profile picture in sign-up step 3 (sign_in_screens/signUP_step3.dart) before the user uploads their own photo; low contrast so overlaid UI remains legible.

nodes.label: Flutter Default App Icon (Flutter logo)
nodes.rationale: All viewed icons show the unmodified default Flutter blue chevron logo; the app has not yet been given custom branding.
